name: Project Management (OpenUP Capability Pattern)
description: EPF/OpenUP's Project Management capability pattern, modelled as a Pack: the Project Manager role, planning/risk work products, and the tasks for planning, coordinating, and monitoring the engineering effort.

capabilities.name: Project Management
capabilities.description: Plans, coordinates, and monitors the engineering effort, on behalf of the Project Manager role.

services.name: Project Plan
services.contractDescription: The overall approach, phases, and milestones for the engineering effort.

services.name: Iteration Plan
services.contractDescription: The scope and objectives committed to for the current iteration.

services.name: Risk List
services.contractDescription: Identified risks, their exposure, and their mitigation or contingency.

checklists.statement: A Project Plan exists covering scope, phases, and milestones.
checklists.prompt: Does a Project Plan exist covering scope, phases, and milestones?

checklists.statement: An Iteration Plan exists with committed scope the team has agreed to.
checklists.prompt: Does an Iteration Plan exist with scope the team has explicitly committed to?

checklists.statement: Risks are identified, assessed, and have an owner and mitigation.
checklists.prompt: Are the risks on the Risk List assessed, owned, and carrying a mitigation or contingency?
